name: GitHub
author: mulm
description: Local repos and GitHub at a glance: unpushed commits, commit history, CI, PRs, notifications and contributions.

barWidget.description: Unpushed/behind commit counts in the bar; click for repos with commit history, push/pull/lazygit actions, CI state, PRs, review requests and the contribution graph.

schema.label: Repo folders
schema.description: Comma-separated folders; each folder and its direct subfolders are scanned for git repos.

schema.label: Repos listed
schema.description: Most recently committed repos shown; repos with unpushed or unpulled commits are always shown.

schema.label: Notification count in bar
schema.description: Also show the unread GitHub notification count next to the icon.
